$comment: Fact ledger for /wordpress-hosting, built by /write-content on 2026-10-11 from project files only. Claim facts follow content/claims.ts: only claims that render may be stated. A person confirms the ledger at APPROVAL 1.

facts.fact: In prose the name is DronaHost; the domain is dronahost.com
facts.checkedBy: Claude (fact-checker, 2026-10-11), owner to confirm at APPROVAL 1

facts.fact: DronaHost is a managed WordPress hosting and web services company for businesses, freelancers and agencies worldwide
facts.checkedBy: Claude (fact-checker, 2026-10-11), owner to confirm at APPROVAL 1

facts.fact: WordPress hosting has three plans: Starter (one small business or personal brand site), Growth (small businesses, WooCommerce stores and busy blogs; marked Recommended) and Pro (agencies with a few client sites and larger WooCommerce stores)

source.ref: data/pricing.json; owner confirmed the WordPress plan limits on 2026-10-11 (decision 61)

facts.fact: Plan limits: Starter 1 site, 20 GB storage, 2 GB RAM; Growth 10 sites, 60 GB, 4 GB RAM; Pro 25 sites, 120 GB, 6 GB RAM

source.ref: data/pricing.json; owner confirmed the WordPress plan limits on 2026-10-11 (decision 61)

facts.fact: Monthly traffic: Starter 200 GB and Growth 500 GB (metered); Pro is fair use, linked to the fair-use policy, never 'unlimited'

source.ref: data/pricing.json; owner confirmed the WordPress plan limits on 2026-10-11 (decision 61)

facts.fact: Storage is NVMe SSD on every plan
LiteSpeed web servers: NOT used. Owner, 2026-10-11: caching is NGINX caching. Never say LiteSpeed
SSH access and WP-CLI on every plan
facts.checkedBy: Owner withdrew 2026-10-11 (decision 66): SSH and WP-CLI are not offered, for security

facts.fact: Staging with clone and sync is available on every WordPress plan through the Plesk WP Toolkit (owner, 2026-10-11, corrects the earlier 'not offered')
Automatic backups: daily, the latest copy is kept, on every plan

source.ref: owner, 2026-10-11, answers to the brief's open flags (decision 61)

facts.fact: Free migration to DronaHost: free on every package, one website per package
facts.checkedBy: Claude (fact-checker, 2026-10-11), owner to confirm at APPROVAL 1

facts.fact: Migration steps (owner's words: 'they share the access of old hosting, we transfer ask permisioonn, then point DNS, then done'): you share access to your old hosting; we transfer the site; we ask your permission; the DNS is pointed to DronaHost; done. The old site keeps serving visitors until the DNS is pointed. A review on a private link is NOT part of the owner's description
Renewal price equals the signup price, with no end date
facts.checkedBy: Claude (fact-checker, 2026-10-11), owner to confirm at APPROVAL 1

facts.fact: 30-day money-back guarantee
facts.checkedBy: Claude (fact-checker, 2026-10-11), owner to confirm at APPROVAL 1

facts.fact: 99.99% uptime SLA with service credits on every hosting plan
facts.checkedBy: Claude (fact-checker, 2026-10-11), owner to confirm at APPROVAL 1

facts.fact: Support is by ticket and email, 24 hours a day, every day, on every plan including Starter, with no promised reply time

source.ref: owner, 2026-10-11 (24/7 on every plan); content/claims.ts support-24-7; /support-policy; pricing.json Starter availability set to 24/7 the same day

facts.fact: No live chat, WhatsApp or phone support
facts.checkedBy: Claude (fact-checker, 2026-10-11), owner to confirm at APPROVAL 1

facts.fact: Email is not included with any hosting plan; Business Email (Google Workspace) is a separate service
facts.checkedBy: Claude (fact-checker, 2026-10-11), owner to confirm at APPROVAL 1

facts.fact: Automatic WordPress updates and NGINX caching on every WordPress plan

source.ref: owner, 2026-10-11, answers to the brief's open flags (decision 61)

facts.fact: Redis object cache and automated plugin testing are NOT offered (owner, 2026-10-11)
Malware scanning and advanced security on every plan. WooCommerce optimization is only on the Business hosting plans, not on WordPress hosting

source.ref: owner, 2026-10-11, answers to the brief's open flags (decision 61)

facts.fact: A free domain for the first year on every plan, with annual billing only. Eligible domain endings and the renewal price are not set

source.ref: owner, 2026-10-11, answers to the brief's open flags (decision 61)

facts.fact: Free SSL certificates from Let's Encrypt on every plan
Prices appear only on /pricing; plan cards on this page link there
facts.checkedBy: Claude (fact-checker, 2026-10-11), owner to confirm at APPROVAL 1

facts.fact: DronaHost owns no data centers and has no fixed server location per plan; no city, provider or 'our servers' wording
facts.checkedBy: Claude (fact-checker, 2026-10-11), owner to confirm at APPROVAL 1

facts.fact: mjcbdd.com is not on a WordPress hosting plan (owner, 2026-10-11): the case study stays off this page
usedIn: CaseStudy (only if the site is on a WordPress hosting plan)

facts.fact: Support includes WordPress fixes in tickets (errors, plugin conflicts, settings) and installing and updating premium themes and plugins the customer has a license for
Redis object cache and automated plugin testing are not offered on any plan (staging is offered, see F9)

Divi, Elementor Pro and Astra are supplied on every plan as GPL-licensed software (owner: 'for all plans, since wordpress theme and plugins comes with "General Public License (GPL)" so we can offer it our in house websites'). Wording must not imply a vendor license key, vendor support or a partnership
Spam and adult websites are not allowed on DronaHost

WordPress hosting runs on the Plesk control panel with the WP Toolkit (Files, Plugins, Themes, Database, WP-CLI, Clone, Copy Data, Back Up / Restore, Let's Encrypt, NGINX caching), seen in the owner's dashboard screenshot of 2026-10-11

source.ref: owner screenshot of the Plesk dashboard, 2026-10-11 (held privately: it shows a customer's domain, name and IP, so it is never published)

facts.fact: Three security layers on every plan: a firewall, brute-force login protection and malware scanning. Two backup layers: a local copy and an offsite copy, both daily, each overwriting the previous copy
usedIn: FeatureGrid (only once each layer is named)

facts.fact: Paid extras: premium SSL (no price in the pricing file yet), extra offsite backup and Extra Layer Security. The Automatic Malware Scanning add-on is removed because scanning is included on every plan
Served through the Cloudflare network
Customers manage files, databases, plugins, themes, staging and backups from the control panel on every WordPress plan; the panel is called "control panel" on public pages, never by its product name
DronaHost hosts WordPress sites from every industry; online stores, agencies, local businesses and bloggers are examples, not limits. Spam and adult websites are not allowed
